description: This file defines the LanguageSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class and specifies filtering parameters for language search functionality within the OrangeHRM admin module. It sets allowed sort fields and initializes the default sort field to 'l.name'.

classes.name: LanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class used for specifying search filter parameters for language entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the filter parameters, particularly setting the default sort field to 'l.name'.
